column1: # R2 author-declared pin markers — HAND-VERIFIED allow-list for migrate-pin-markers.py
# Token: `` pin:`<sha>` ``, per manuscript/ave-kb/CONVENTIONS.md, "Author-declared
# pin marker" (written 2026-08-06). Not coined here and not re-spelled here.
# Format: <source repo-relative path> TAB <line in source> TAB <cite as written>
# A row lands here only after a human RESOLVED THE CITED LINE BOTH WAYS — read
# it at HEAD (absent) and at the SHA on its row (present, and saying what the
# citing prose says it says). The classifier proposes; this file disposes. Its
# measured TRUE-PIN precision is 2/5 over the whole corpus population — measured
# independently twice, on 2026-09-07, by two readers who did not share notes and
# who landed on the same two cites — so the classifier alone is not licence to
# rewrite anything.

# are itemised, with their both-ways reads, in §4 of
